description: Scrape Pinterest pins, boards, and user profiles. No login needed.

boardUrls.description: Public board links or `username/board-name` paths, for example `https://www.pinterest.com/nasa/ceres/`.
boardUrls.title: Board URLs

commerceOnly.description: Pro filter: when true, return only product/shoppable pins. Equivalent to Pinterest's native 'Products' filter (commerce_only=true).
commerceOnly.title: Commerce only (shoppable pins)

cookies.description: Optional Cookie Editor JSON export. All public modes work without cookies; never share this secret publicly.
cookies.title: Optional Pinterest cookies

cookiesJson.description: Compatibility alias for pasting a Cookie Editor JSON export.
cookiesJson.title: Optional cookies JSON (alias)

enrichPinDetails.description: For `userPins` and `boardPins`, visit each public Pin detail page for detail-only fields. Slower but more complete.
enrichPinDetails.title: Enrich collection Pins

ideaSlugs.description: Idea topic path pairs such as `beauty/935541271955`. Used when `mode=ideas`.
ideaSlugs.title: Idea topic paths

ideaUrls.description: Public Pinterest idea-topic links, for example `https://www.pinterest.com/ideas/beauty/935541271955/`.
ideaUrls.title: Idea topic URLs

imageOnly.description: Drop video pins, keep image pins only.
imageOnly.title: Image-only (Pro filter)

includeComments.description: Add real comment/activity rows for collected Pins. Pinterest's public cookieless path is used automatically.
includeComments.title: Include Pin comments

keywords.description: Words or phrases for search modes, for example `minimalist home office`.
keywords.title: Search words

language.description: Pinterest UI language (affects ranked search results).
language.title: Language

maxComments.description: Maximum public comment/activity rows per Pin when comments are enabled or mode=comments.
maxComments.title: Maximum comments per Pin

maxItems.description: Maximum rows returned across all supplied inputs.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPages.description: Maximum search result pages to walk per keyword or board (1 page ≈ 25 pins). Default 10.
maxPages.title: Max pages

minCreatorFollowers.description: Keep Pins whose public creator follower count reaches N. Unknown counts are retained.
minCreatorFollowers.title: Min creator followers

minSaves.description: Keep Pins whose Pinterest save count is at least N. Pins without a published count are retained as unknown.
minSaves.title: Min saves (Pro filter)

mode.description: Choose the Pinterest use case. The legacy `search` value remains accepted for existing users.
enumTitles: Comments and Pin activity by URL
mode.title: What to collect

pinUrls.description: Public Pinterest pin links or numeric IDs (used when mode=`pinDetail`).
pinUrls.title: Pin URLs

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify proxy settings. Public direct-pin pages do not require login; some feed surfaces may be withheld from datacenter traffic.
proxyConfiguration.title: Optional proxy

requireOutboundLink.description: For Pin results, keep only Pins with a public destination URL supplied by Pinterest.
requireOutboundLink.title: Require destination link

startUrls.description: Mixed public Pinterest links for mode=`auto`. Each unambiguous Pin, profile, board, idea, or search link is routed to the matching collector; unsupported section links are skipped.
startUrls.title: Pinterest URLs (auto-detect)

urls.description: Compatibility alias for pinUrls, useful with mode=comments.
urls.title: Pin URLs (comments alias)

usernames.description: Pinterest usernames, @usernames, or public profile links.
usernames.title: Pinterest usernames

verifiedOnly.description: Keep only rows where Pinterest explicitly reports a verified creator or profile.
verifiedOnly.title: Verified accounts only

title: Pinterest Scraper Pro Input
